prompt:
A30-second, 16:9 photorealistic Unreal Engine 5 third-person fantasy action-adventure gameplay sequence. Make it feel like real playable AAA gameplay with seamless movement, realistic physics, dynamic camera work, and minimal HUD.

A young explorer in weathered winter gear, fur-lined cloak, climbing equipment, curved sword, and a glowing silver-blue wind device explores a gigantic frozen temple suspended above the clouds. Maintain strict character and equipment consistency.

0–5s — Frozen Summit
The explorer climbs an icy wall, jumps onto a collapsing platform, then sprints across a narrow frozen bridge as massive ice chunks fall into the clouds. The camera pulls wide to reveal the enormous temple.

5–10s — Wind Traversal
The bridge collapses. The explorer activates the wind device, launches across the gap, grabs a hanging chain, swings around an ancient turbine, and lands on another platform.

10–15s — Temple Awakens
Inside a massive crystal-filled chamber, the explorer activates three ancient wind mechanisms. A frozen gate explodes open, revealing a gigantic winged creature awakening above the chamber.

15–21s — Escape
The temple begins collapsing. The explorer runs across rotating platforms, dodges falling stone, and uses the wind ability to glide toward the exit while the creature destroys platforms behind them.

21–26s — Boss Arena
The explorer bursts onto a huge circular platform above the clouds. The creature crashes through the temple roof. Snow and ice explode across the arena as the player draws their sword.

26–30s — Epic Combat
The creature unleashes a massive wing attack. The explorer dodges underneath, uses the wind device to expose a glowing chest crystal, then strikes it with the sword. Blue energy fractures spread across the creature as its health bar drops. End with the player charging forward as the creature prepares its next attack.

Photorealistic AAA gameplay, realistic snow and ice physics, cinematic lighting, volumetric clouds, detailed ancient architecture, natural cloth and hair movement, believable creature weight, smooth 60fps motion, continuous player-controlled camera.

No montage cuts, no gore, no blood, no modern weapons, no subtitles, no logos, no watermark, no black bars, no fade-out.

translations.zh:
一段30秒、16:9超写实虚幻引擎5第三人称奇幻动作冒险游戏画面。具备流畅移动、写实物理、动态镜头和极简HUD。

一名身穿做旧冬装、毛皮斗篷、攀爬装备、配有弯刀和发光银蓝风之装置的年轻探险家在悬浮于云海上的巨型冰冻神殿中探险。保持角色与装备一致性。

0–5秒：攀爬冰墙与跑过狭窄冰桥；
5–10秒：利用风之装置穿梭与抓链摇摆；
10–15秒：激活风之机制触发巨门开启并惊醒翼兽；
15–21秒：平台塌陷逃脱；
21–26秒：进入Boss竞技场并拔剑对峙；
26–30秒：闪避攻击击碎水晶弱点。

写实AAA游戏画面，无蒙太奇剪辑、无水印血腥。
translations.en: A 30-second, 16:9 photorealistic Unreal Engine 5 third-person fantasy action-adventure gameplay sequence featuring an explorer in a frozen sky temple confronting a winged boss creature.
